subject: english
question:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.

Her critique, couched in ironic precision (1)/ and elliptical disclosures (2)/, invite a reconstitution (3)/ of the very foundations of authorship. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in part (3), where the verb "invite" is incorrectly used.
 
• The subject of the sentence, "Her critique," is singular and requires a singular verb.
 
• The correct verb form should be "invites" instead of "invite."
 
• Thus, the grammatical error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Her critique, couched in ironic precision and elliptical disclosures, **invites** a reconstitution of the very foundations of authorship."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "Her critique, couched in ironic precision" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 2: "and elliptical disclosures" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "of the very foundations of authorship" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
